intent: Make check-test-suite-invocation recognise a suite command already held under with-suite-mutex (including a shell -c body), never emit a doubled with-suite-mutex remedy, and stop the -k/-m "name test files" note from appearing on a Tier-U-granted broad run.
name: suite-mutex-guard-wrapped-shell
premise_evidence: Read check_test_suite_invocation.py: _expand_segments replaces a chained sh -c segment with its payload segments, so _command_wrapped_in_suite_mutex sees the inner pytest segment without the with-suite-mutex prefix; _deny_reason_wrapper_required blindly prefixes the command; _selection_flag_note is appended regardless of grant. Guard is registered BOX_DEGRADING in deny_registry (irreversible class, so denying is legal) but the false positive is an engine bug. One module plus its test file, no unknown mechanisms.
